desc.zh: 从两栋楼的屋顶推导端点扫描与延迟删除堆。
desc.en: Derive an endpoint sweep and lazy heap removal from two overlapping roofs.

complexity: O(n log n) time; O(n) auxiliary space and O(n) output

concepts.name: skyline endpoint sweep
concepts.description: Group equal-coordinate events and retain the tallest unexpired heap root.

concepts.name: lazy heap removal
concepts.description: Prove why expired entries below the root can be removed later.
